column1: # Reference apps (plan, principle 6, and lane BC): open source Cocoa
# apps whose system imports drive the framework work. symbol-inventory.py
# parses them, and gate BC (boottest GATE=BC) runs their published
# binaries, downloaded on the build host and never copied into the
# repository or the released images. A new version is a new line here
# with its sha256 (sha256sum of the download).
# Added 2026-11-11: native Cocoa apps that cover the system more widely;
# Firefox is Minkar's browser and Thunderbird its mail client.
